paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different sentiment analysis tools – TextBlob, VADER, and ChatGPT – across two categories of tweets: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet”. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet", in that order, while the vertical axis represents “Accuracy” on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Three bars are present for each category, each representing a specific tool; the bars are differentiated by color, with TextBlob represented by a white bar with black hash marks, VADER by a dark green bar, and ChatGPT by a lighter shade of green. For “Emoji Tweets”, TextBlob has an approximate accuracy of 0.36, VADER around 0.64, and ChatGPT approximately 0.73. For “Overall Tweet”, TextBlob achieves about 0.48 accuracy, VADER approximately 0.62, and ChatGPT around 0.71. The bars within each category are grouped side-by-side, enabling visual comparison of the tools’ performance for each tweet type. No bars are visibly emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation, and the bars are arranged in the order of TextBlob, VADER, and ChatGPT for each category.
